title: French Beans (Frasbean): modeled ₹677/qtl left, Solan → Palampur
summary: January 2023: reported french Beans (Frasbean) prices at Solan and Palampur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 75% of 12 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹677 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 246 same-variety market pairs screened for french Beans (Frasbean) in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Palampur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Solan (Himachal Pradesh) and Palampur (Himachal Pradesh) both reported french Beans (Frasbean) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 12 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Solan reported a median ₹2,800 per quintal. Palampur reported a median ₹3,625 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹875/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹875 per quintal, and Palampur was dearer on 83% of days.

scenes.headline: 286 km by road
scenes.caption: 286 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹61/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹517 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹325 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Palampur report, the rule selects 8 of 12 modeled shipping days. 8 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹677 per quintal (₹479 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Solan to Palampur was positive on 75% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹67,700, or ₹47,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to french Beans (Frasbean)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹61/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Solan to Palampur was positive on 75% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹67,700, or ₹47,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scenes.caption: 161 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹35/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹503 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹298 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Hamirpur (Nadaun) report, the rule selects 15 of 17 modeled shipping days. 15 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹718 per quintal (₹515 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Kullu to Hamirpur (Nadaun) was positive on 88% of matched days in December 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹71,800, or ₹51,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
